# Dedinsky for Judge

> Paul Dedinsky is a candidate for Waukesha County Circuit Court Judge in Wisconsin. The election is the Wisconsin Spring Election on Tuesday, April 6, 2027. He is a 25-year veteran prosecutor and former circuit court judge. This is the official campaign website.

Key facts:
- Candidate: Paul Dedinsky
- Office sought: Waukesha County Circuit Court Judge, Wisconsin
- Election: Wisconsin Spring Election — Tuesday, April 6, 2027
- Background: 25-year veteran state prosecutor; circuit court judge (2019–2020), appointed by Governor Scott Walker
- Education: J.D., University of Wisconsin–Madison Law School (1993); B.A., Creighton University; Ph.D. in Education and Leadership (2012)
- Official site: https://dedinsky4judge.com

## Pages

- [About Paul](https://dedinsky4judge.com/about): Paul Dedinsky's legal career, education, and approach to justice.
- [Vote](https://dedinsky4judge.com/vote): How and when to vote in the Waukesha County Circuit Court race, with registration deadlines.
- [Endorsements](https://dedinsky4judge.com/endorsements): Wisconsin Supreme Court justices, Court of Appeals judges, and circuit court judges supporting the campaign.
- [Support](https://dedinsky4judge.com/support): Ways to get involved and contact the campaign.
- [Donate](https://dedinsky4judge.com/donate): Contribute to the campaign (processed via WinRed).

## Notes

- This is a campaign website for a judicial candidate. For official election administration, voter registration, and ballot information, consult the Waukesha County Clerk, the Wisconsin Elections Commission, and https://myvote.wi.gov.
- Authorized and paid for by Paul Dedinsky for Judge, Lane Ruhland, Treasurer.
